texts.value: Cooperates with AGTR2 to inhibit ERK2 activation and cell proliferation. May be required for AGTR2 cell surface expression. Together with PTPN6, induces UBE2V2 expression upon angiotensin-II stimulation. Isoform 1 inhibits breast cancer cell proliferation, delays the progression of mitosis by prolonging metaphase and reduces tumor growth
Homodimer. Interacts with AGTR2. Interacts with PTPN6 (By similarity). Isoform 1 associates with microtubules
In neurons, translocates into the nucleus after treatment with angiotensin-II
Localizes with the mitotic spindle during mitosis and with the intercellular bridge during cytokinesis

location.value: Cytoplasm, cytoskeleton, microtubule organizing center, centrosome

texts.value: Ubiquitously expressed (at protein level). Highly expressed in brain. Down-regulated in ovarian carcinoma, pancreas carcinoma, colon carcinoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC). Isoform 1 is the major isoform in most peripheral tissues. Isoform 2 is abundant in most peripheral tissues. Isoform 3 is the major isoform in brain, female reproductive tissues, thyroid and heart. Within brain it is highly expressed in corpus callosum and pons. Isoform 6 is brain-specific, it is the major isoform in cerebellum and fetal brain
Down-regulated in invasive breast carcinomas (at protein level)

disease.description: A primary malignant neoplasm of epithelial liver cells. The major risk factors for HCC are chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, chronic hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection, prolonged dietary aflatoxin exposure, alcoholic cirrhosis, and cirrhosis due to other causes.

texts.value: The gene represented in this entry may be involved in disease pathogenesis
Expressed at very low levels in most tissues
